_readme: Draft default promotion criteria, keyed by the same discipline/canonical-belt values as beltTaxonomy.json. NOT wired to anything live yet - this is data for a future per-gym seed script to copy into the `promotionCriteria` table (which requires a gymId per row; that gets filled in at insert time, not here). 'belt' in each entry is the rank being promoted INTO, matching the convention documented on schema.ts's promotionCriteria table. requiredSessions/requiredDaysAtRank are rough, defensible industry-norm defaults for a typical independent gym - every gym owner should be able to override these per-belt once the real UI for that exists; nothing here is meant to be authoritative.

bjj_adult.notes: Adult BJJ promotion timelines vary a lot by gym/instructor - these are rough averages (rounded), not IBJJF minimums. requiredDaysAtRank is the floor; requiredSessions assumes roughly 2-3x/week average attendance over that period.

bjj_kids.notes: Kids progress faster and on shorter cycles than adults - evaluation leans more on attendance/behavior/basic skill checks than pure mat time. Numbers below are a flat default across the whole 12-belt IBJJF kids progression; a real gym would likely scale these up slightly for the older orange/green brackets, which this draft doesn't attempt to model.

muay_thai.notes: Most gyms use no_rank (see beltTaxonomy.json) and have no promotion criteria at all - those rows are included at 0/0 for completeness, not because a real gym would enforce them. The armband progression only applies to gyms that have opted into that optional system.

wrestling.notes: No rank system exists in wrestling (see beltTaxonomy.json) - included only so every discipline has a matching entry; a gym should never actually populate this table for wrestling.

mma.notes: No rank system exists for MMA itself (see beltTaxonomy.json) - included only so every discipline has a matching entry; a gym should never actually populate this table for MMA.
